app.name: TrafonDart
app.tagline: Darts scoring, ratings and tournaments for the crew

common.provisionalHint: Rating is still settling – it moves faster for the first matches.

auth.registerLead: You need an invite code from an admin in the group.
auth.realNameHint: Shown next to your username, e.g. Kari Nordmann.
auth.expired: Your session expired. Log in again and you'll be back where you were.

home.noLiveLead: No matches are being played right now. Start one and the others can watch every dart.

match.newLead: Pick the players and the rules, then hand the tablet to the board.

outHint.DOUBLE: Finish on a double or the bull.
outHint.MASTER: Finish on a double, treble or the bull.

inHint.STRAIGHT: Every dart counts from the start.

match.outOfSync: Another device scored at the same time. Showing the latest state.
match.abandonConfirm: Abandon this match? It will not count for ratings or stats.
match.disputeLead: An admin will review it. If they agree, the match is voided and ratings are recalculated.
match.notScorer: Only the players or the person who set up the match can score it.

stats.noMatchesYet: No finished matches yet – the dashboard fills up after the first one.

players.title: Players
players.lead: Ordered by Glicko-2 rating. Ratings marked provisional are still settling.

tournament.title: Tournaments
tournament.lead: Round-robin leagues and knockout cups. Brackets fill themselves in as matches finish.
tournament.newLead: Pick a format and the players. Seeds are set by rating when you start.
tournament.name: Name

formatHints.ROUND_ROBIN: Everyone plays everyone once. Most points wins.
formatHints.SINGLE_ELIMINATION: Lose once and you're out. Top seeds get byes.

tournament.startHint: Starting generates all fixtures. Players can't be changed afterwards.
tournament.cancelConfirm: Cancel this tournament? Matches already played keep counting for ratings.
tournament.empty: No tournaments yet. Start the first one.

admin.title: Admin
admin.newInviteLead: Each code can be used a set number of times before it expires.
admin.inviteOnce: Copy it now – for security only a hash is stored, so it can't be shown again.
admin.revokeConfirm: Revoke this code? Nobody else can sign up with it.
admin.noDisputes: No reports. Everybody agrees on the scores.
admin.voidConfirm: Void this match? It disappears from stats and all ratings are recalculated.
admin.resetHow: Copy the link and send it, for example on Messenger. It works once, for 24 hours, and the person chooses a new password themselves and is logged in. You never see the password. All the person's other logins are ended, and any lock-out after wrong passwords is lifted.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Saved to your account so it follows you to other devices.
settings.soundHint: Chimes for 180s, big finishes and busts.
settings.callerHint: Reads out every turn score, like on TV.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been logged out.
settings.logoutAllHint: Ends every session on every device, including this one.
settings.exportHint: Download everything TrafonDart stores about you: profile, matches with every dart, games, comments, ratings, awards.
settings.deleteHint: Delete your account for good. Your matches stay for your opponents, shown as played by a deleted player.
settings.deleteKeeps: Matches and results stay, but your name is replaced by “Deleted player”.
settings.deleteRemoves: Your comments, kudos and likes are removed, and open challenges called off.
settings.deleteForever: You can't log in again, and this can't be undone.
settings.deletedDone: Your account has been deleted. Thanks for the games.

notFound.title: Missed the board
notFound.lead: That page doesn't exist. Maybe the link is old, or has a typo in it.

match.title: Match not found
match.lead: The match doesn't exist, or it has been deleted.

game.title: Game not found
game.lead: The game doesn't exist, or it has been deleted.

player.title: Player not found
player.lead: Nobody in the crew has that username.

tournament.title: Tournament not found
tournament.lead: The tournament doesn't exist, or it has been deleted.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to do that.
errors.CONFLICT: Something changed in the meantime. Reload and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.CSRF_INVALID: Your session expired. Reload the page and try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: The server hit an error. Try again in a moment.
errors.AUTH_ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account has been disabled. Talk to an admin.
errors.INVITE_INVALID: That invite code doesn't exist. Check for typos.
errors.INVITE_EXPIRED: That invite code has expired. Ask an admin for a new one.
errors.INVITE_USED_UP: That invite code has been used up. Ask an admin for a new one.
errors.INVITE_REVOKED: That invite code was revoked. Ask an admin for a new one.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: There must always be at least one active admin.
errors.CANNOT_CHANGE_SELF: You can't change your own role or access.
errors.MATCH_OUT_OF_SYNC: Another device scored at the same time. Showing the latest state.
errors.MATCH_NOT_SCORER: Only the players or the person who set up the match can score it.
errors.DISPUTE_NOT_ALLOWED: Only players in a finished match can report it.
errors.DISPUTE_ALREADY_OPEN: This match has already been reported.
errors.DISPUTE_TOURNAMENT_LOCKED: The winner has already played on in the tournament, so this match can't be voided.
errors.TOURNAMENT_TOO_FEW_PLAYERS: A tournament needs at least two players.
errors.TOURNAMENT_TOO_MANY_PLAYERS: A tournament can have at most 32 players.
errors.FIXTURE_NOT_READY: This fixture is waiting for earlier results.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Can't reach the server. The free server may be waking up – give it a minute.
errors.KUDOS_OWN_MATCH: You can't give kudos to your own match.
errors.RESET_LINK_INVALID: This link doesn't work any more. Ask an admin for a new one.
errors.BAD_PATH: That link doesn't look right. Go back and try again.
errors.CHALLENGE_NOT_OPEN: That challenge isn't open any more.
errors.CHALLENGE_EXISTS: You two already have an open challenge.
errors.CHALLENGE_LIMIT: You already have 5 open challenges. Wait for some answers first.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: This device has no connection. Check Wi-Fi or mobile data and try again.

waking.title: The server is waking up
waking.body: The free server sleeps when nobody is playing and takes up to a minute to get up. We'll keep trying.

session.title: You've been logged out
session.body: Your session expired. Log in again to carry on.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.body: You don't have access to this.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.body: It doesn't exist, or it has been deleted.

rateLimited.title: A few too many tries
rateLimited.body: Wait half a minute, then try again.

server.title: The server hit an error
server.body: The error has been reported. Try again in a moment.

invalid.title: That didn't work
invalid.body: Check what you entered and try again.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.body: Try again. If it keeps happening, report the bug.

social.ownMatch: You can't give kudos to your own match.
social.noComments: No comments yet. Be the first to say something about this match.

analysis.winProbabilityHint: Based on both players' Glicko-2 ratings when the match started.
analysis.scoreBandsHint: How many turns landed in each score range.
analysis.heatmapHint: Brighter segments were hit more often. Hover or tap a segment for the count.
analysis.raceHint: Remaining score after each turn in leg {{n}}.
analysis.h2hNone: This is their first match against each other.

nerd.title: Darts nerd corner
nerd.lead: Every dart this player has thrown in finished matches.
nerd.breakHint: Legs won when the opponent threw first

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.lead: Hi {{name}}! Pick a new password for @{{username}}. You'll be logged in straight away.
reset.invalidLead: Reset links work once and expire after 24 hours. Ask an admin for a new one.

feedback.title: Found a bug?
feedback.lead: Something broken, confusing or just wrong? Send an email and tell us about it.
feedback.include1: What you were trying to do
feedback.include3: Which page you were on, and your phone or browser
feedback.subject: TrafonDart: bug report

forgot.hint: Forgot your password? Ask an admin for a reset link.

awards.title: Player of the Month
awards.lead: Not just for the best player: points come from improving, playing a lot and the big moments. A new champion is crowned on the 1st of every month.
awards.noRace: Nobody has finished a match this month yet. The first match puts you on the board.
awards.noHall: No months decided yet. The first winners are crowned on the 1st.

how.rating: 1 point per rating point gained this month, up to 60 (a bad month costs at most 25)
how.activity: 4 points per finished match, up to 20 matches
how.improvement: 2 points per point your 3-dart average beats your own earlier average (−20 to +40)
how.highlights: 3 points per 180 and 5 points per checkout of 100 or more
how.kudos: 1 point per kudos on your matches, up to 10
how.eligible: You need at least {{count}} finished matches in the month to be Player of the Month. 180s and finishes count for everyone.

awards.cabinetEmpty: No badges yet. Every month is a new chance.
awards.yearRaceLead_one: All month points added up. Needs {{count}} rated match in the year; crowned on 1 January.
awards.yearRaceLead_other: All month points added up. Needs {{count}} rated matches in the year; crowned on 1 January.
awards.yearHallEmpty: The first one is crowned on 1 January.

offline.title: No connection.
offline.waiting_one: {{count}} dart is saved on this tablet and will be sent when the connection is back.
offline.waiting_other: {{count}} darts are saved on this tablet and will be sent when the connection is back.
offline.banner: You're offline. What you see may be out of date.

crash.title: Something broke
crash.lead: This page crashed. We've been told about it. Reloading usually helps.
crash.updateLead: TrafonDart was updated since you opened this page. Reload to get the new version.

waking.title: Waking up the server
waking.lead: The server naps when nobody is playing. It's getting up – usually in under a minute.

games.newLead: X01 for three or four, two against two, Cricket, Killer or Around the Clock. Just for fun: party games never count towards rating or awards.

typeHint.X01: Count down to zero, like a normal match, with three or four players – or two teams of two.
typeHint.CRICKET: Close 20 to 15 and the bull (three marks each). Points on numbers you've closed and others haven't.
typeHint.KILLER: Everyone gets a number. Hit your own double to become a killer, then take lives with the others' doubles.
typeHint.AROUND_THE_CLOCK: Hit 1, 2, 3 … 20 and the bull in order. The first one all the way round wins. Works on your own, too.

games.teamsHint: Partners take turns; first two chosen are team A.
games.roundLimitHint: After this many rounds, most points wins.
games.skipsHint: A double moves you two numbers on, a treble three.
games.pickTeams: Tap four players: the first two are team A, the last two team B.

lineup.tooMany: Too many players for this game.
lineup.teamsNeedFour: Two against two needs exactly four players.
lineup.noTeams: This game is played every man for himself.
lineup.x01Two: Two players? Start a normal match instead – it counts for rating.

games.neverRated: Party games never count towards rating, Player of the Month or the Year.
games.abandonConfirm: Stop this game? It won't count anywhere.

howTo.X01: Score as usual: three darts per player, bust resets the turn.
howTo.CRICKET: Darts outside 15–20 and the bull simply count as no score.
howTo.KILLER: Tap the double you hit. Doubles on others' numbers take a life once you're a killer.
howTo.AROUND_THE_CLOCK: Tap what you hit; only the next number in line counts.

recap.title: {{name}}'s {{year}}
recap.poyLead: {{name}} was the best of the lot. Take a bow.
recap.dartsLead: Every three of them a trip to the board and back: about {{km}} km walked.
recap.promoLead: Darts thrown, best month, favourite finish and your nemesis.

BULL_FINISH.how: Win a leg on the bull.

SHORT_LEG.title: Short leg
SHORT_LEG.how: Win a 501 leg in 15 darts or fewer.

NINE_DARTER.title: Nine-darter
NINE_DARTER.how: Win a 501 leg in nine darts. The perfect leg.

AVERAGE_50.title: Fifty club
AVERAGE_50.how: Average 50 or more in a match (301 and up).

AVERAGE_70.title: Seventy club
AVERAGE_70.how: Average 70 or more in a match (301 and up).

GIANT_KILLER.title: Giant killer
GIANT_KILLER.how: Win a rated match against someone rated 150 or more above you.

PLAYER_OF_MONTH.title: Player of the Month
PLAYER_OF_MONTH.how: Be crowned Player of the Month.

PLAYER_OF_YEAR.title: Player of the Year
PLAYER_OF_YEAR.how: Be crowned Player of the Year.

CLOCK_UNDER_40.title: Clockwork
CLOCK_UNDER_40.how: Finish Around the Clock in under 40 darts.

challenges.title: Challenges
challenges.howItWorks: They get 48 hours to accept. Then the match waits on both your home pages – press Start at the board.
